upstreams.name: Noctalia
upstreams.adaptation: The read-only KWin observer pattern was reduced to an Obsidience-namespaced script and bounded D-Bus state feed. Window activation, closing, pointer movement, renderer, UI, themes, assets, plugins, configuration, state and IPC were excluded.

upstreams.name: Quickshell
upstreams.adaptation: Used as the installed Qt Quick and Wayland layer-shell runtime. Obsidience owns all QML, presentation, state and behavior; no upstream source or visual design was copied.

upstreams.name: Omarchy quattro shell
upstreams.adaptation: Architecture reference only: one long-running Quickshell host, self-contained feature packages, shared service injection and on-demand loading. No source, renderer, visual design, Hyprland integration, shell scripts, configuration or IPC implementation was copied.
